opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants are encouraged from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities, with a strong encouragement for partnership applications that involve racially minoritised communities.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges, and aims to contribute to understanding, public debate, policy and practice on tackling racial inequalities.

opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be based in the UK; organisations must have a formal employment or contractual relationship with a UK host institution for the project duration. Projects led by individuals without such affiliation, schools, undergraduates, PhD fee projects, or establishment of academic posts are not funded.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £500,000 for research addressing priority questions from the Strategic Review, supporting rigorous, impact‑focused projects across social and natural sciences.
